verdict.rationale: Gusto Business Compliance documents filing state annual reports to keep good standing, across all 50 states. Proactive deadline alerts that include annual reports support on-time filing, and CPA Practice Advisor independently corroborates annual report filing. Franchise tax filing is never mentioned; the evidence shows only annual tax reminders, not franchise tax filing. Missing for 10: documented franchise tax filing or payment, hands-on evidence of on-time filing performance.

support.subject: As a founder, I can file annual reports and franchise tax on time through the platform
